notes: JG strategizes with client on talking points, target approach, and event goals.  [orig timing: 4–6 weeks out]

notes: Designator receives email with instructions and logs into GRIP to select up to 40 operators they want to meet with.  [orig timing: 4–6 weeks out]

notes: Mid-window check: review mutual interest signals in GRIP and adjust selections before the final deadline. Note: this often falls in a holiday week.  [orig timing: 4–6 weeks out]

notes: Hard cutoff for all partner preference selections in GRIP. After this, Informa builds the schedule.  [orig timing: 4–6 weeks out]

title: View preliminary meeting schedule + flag issues
notes: Informa publishes a draft schedule. Review each client's 10 meetings and flag any conflicts or mismatches directly with Informa.  [orig timing: 4–6 weeks out]

title: Build master attendee list
notes: LinkedIn headshots, brand, job title, buyer intent. Updated multiple times/week.  [orig timing: 3–4 weeks out]

title: Map buyer intents to clients
notes: Match each operator's top 3 tech priorities to relevant client solutions.  [orig timing: 3–4 weeks out]

title: Create internal dossier
notes: Internal-facing dossier for the 858 team — separate from client dossiers.  [orig timing: 3–4 weeks out]

title: Build per-client dossier in Notion
notes: Agenda, attendee table, buyer intents, map, team/client headshots. One per client.  [orig timing: 3–4 weeks out]

title: Add finalized GRIP schedule to client dossier
notes: Once Informa publishes the preliminary schedule, add each client's confirmed 10 meetings into their Notion dossier so they can research and prep.  [orig timing: 3–4 weeks out]

title: Run prioritization exercise with clients
notes: Clients nominate: 5 tier 1 targets, 5 tier 2, 10 current customers, 20 detractors.  [orig timing: 3–4 weeks out]
